Take a shelter dog out for the day in Washington

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Washington? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 12 shelter programs in Washington, 4 of them open to the public. Cities include Aberdeen, Auburn, Everett, Lynnwood, Port Angeles, Pullman, Seattle, Sequim and more.

Don't see your shelter? Suggest one. Shelter staff can claim a listing.

Other shelters in Washington

These shelters don't run a day-out program that we know of yet. Want to take one of their dogs out? Send a request. Once a month we tell each shelter how many people asked, with a free guide to starting a program.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
